comments.mergedPostDetails:
With it's current implementation, the VRC Camera will display tooltips and controller skeletons in pictures if a user is holding/hovering over an interactable. 

I believe this to be unintended behavior, as it leads to such instances where pictures may be ruined for some who do not want their controllers visible in their pictures. 

Here are some examples taken with the VRC Camera.
https://i.imgur.com/rLHHwx7.png
https://i.imgur.com/q9Dcjzo.png
comments.mergedPostTitle: Disable Controller Skeletons and Tooltips in VRC Camera
comments.value: Just disable the skeleton all together. It's immersion breaking and trust me, I didn't forget where my controllers are
